title: Express, read like a tree

specimen.common: Express (expressjs/express), the Node.js web framework, cut at HEAD
specimen.note: The widest rings are the first two years: hundreds of commits a quarter on the road to 1.0. From 2015 the trunk settles into thin, even growth. The first v5 alpha sits in 2014 Q4, and the v5.0.0 bead only appears thirty-nine rings later.

events.title: 556 commits to 1.0
events.note: the widest ring in the trunk

events.title: 5.0.0-alpha.1
events.note: the final v5 is 39 rings further out

epilogue: Seventy-one quarterly rings and 5,697 commits. Git records TJ Holowaychuk under three spellings (visionmedia, Tj and TJ), so the inner wood shows three rays for one person; repo-rings does not guess at merging names unless the repository ships a .mailmap.
